name: G. Test robot: flywheel wobble grows with speed
description: A perfect robot whose flywheels wobble more the faster they spin (a slightly out-of-true wheel) and drag a little (top speed about 1960 ticks/s, so program 7's 70 % test speed sits at the bottom of the shot table): the ready band at the longest shot speed is clearly wider than program 7's. Used by the shot-speed check test.
